summary: Isolate branch-name Git oracle from parent checkout history

delivery.outcome: Make the literal branch-name Git oracle independent of parent repository/reflog discovery, including TMPDIR within a Git checkout.
nonGoals: No removed cases, ignored failures, timeout changes or new dependencies
No version, changelog, release or target adoption changes

architecture.decision: Create a controlled Git parent with a previous checkout and an empty child oracle directory. Bound discovery at that child parent with GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES, then retain every existing literal-name, bounds, CLI and reconciliation assertion. Verify that unbounded discovery expands @{-1} while the bounded oracle does not discover Git.
architecture.rollback: Revert the fixture-only change after review; production validation and all original cases remain intact.

validation.evidence: Controlled nested Git regression plus all38 literal cases across3 fields, bounds/CLI and27 reconciliation unit cases pass under default SDK Git-nested TMPDIR and nonGit TMPDIR.
Native hub checks and protected Linux/Windows/OneDev CI plus independent exact-head review before merge.
